lines.text: You take a bite#red of a weird white#purple fruit.
lines.say: You take a bite of a weird white fruit.

lines.text: Don't panic,#red that's just a Devil#purple Fruit.#purple
lines.say: Don't panic, that's just a Devil Fruit.

lines.text: Out of every fruit in the sea,#blue
lines.say: Out of every fruit in the sea,

lines.text: a special#orange Paramecia#purple that turns your body into sticky mochi, and it can even awaken.
lines.say: a special Paramecia that turns your body into sticky mochi, and it can even awaken.

lines.text: First, attacks#purple go right through#blue your soft body.

lines.text: Then you shape#red mochi#blue into fists and a giant spear.

lines.text: You can even trap enemies#pink in sticky#purple mochi so they can't move.
lines.say: You can even trap enemies in sticky mochi so they can't move.

lines.text: And once you awaken#pink it, the whole area around#blue you turns into mochi.

lines.text: Its user hid his mouth his whole life because#pink people laughed#purple at it.
lines.say: Its user hid his mouth his whole life because people laughed at it.

lines.text: Charlotte#pink Katakuri, Big Mom's strongest#red son, fought Luffy on Whole Cake Island.
lines.say: Charlotte Katakuri, Big Mom's strongest son, fought Luffy on Whole Cake Island.

lines.text: Users of this fruit never run out of snacks.#purple
lines.say: Users of this fruit never run out of snacks.

lines.text: Which fruit#pink do you want next?#gold Follow for more.
